summary: Iteration 4 backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend (8/8 in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py): (1) GET /api/brand-memory returns exact defaults {enabled:true,tone:'',keywords:[],colors:[]} for a fresh throwaway user; (2) PATCH updates enabled/tone/keywords/colors and GET reflects saved values; (3) PATCH caps keywords at 12 and colors at 8 (submitted 20 & 15, got exactly 12 & 8); (4) unauth GET/PATCH return 401/403; (5) POST /api/projects with brand_keywords=['premium','earthy'] learns both into memory, and a subsequent project with ['luxury'] moves 'luxury' to index 0 (most-recent-first verified); (6) POST /api/brand-kits with auto_generate=true (consumes 1 Claude palette generation, allowed) causes returned kit colors to overlap with brand_memory.colors — colors + style_rules learned; (7) With memory populated (tone+keywords), POST /api/ai/taglines still returns a taglines array and POST /api/ai/refine still returns structured JSON with title/summary/pitch/tasks/brand_keywords — memory enforcement does NOT break generation; (8) Full Idea->Brand Agent flow (RUN ONCE, costs 1 image): /ai/refine -> /projects -> /brand-kits(auto) -> /ai/taglines -> /assets/generate all succeed and /assets/generate returns an asset.image_b64 base64 payload of length >>100 chars. Frontend: (A) Login as demo (via use-demo-button + auth-submit-button) works; onboarding welcome modal handled. (B) Dashboard quick actions include AI Agent + Templates + Insights (testIDs quick-ai-agent, quick-templates, quick-insights all present). (C) Idea->Brand Agent screen (via quick-ai-agent, RUN ONCE on a throwaway signup account 'agentui2_*@creatorforge.app'): idea input filled, agent-run-button tapped, all 5 stepper steps (Refining/Structuring/Designing/Writing/Forging) advanced to checkmark state within ~24s, 'Your brand is forged' title rendered, hero image (data:image/png;base64) rendered inside result card, palette swatches bar rendered, taglines listed, and both agent-open-project + agent-open-kit buttons present. Memory chip (agent-memory-chip) also present linking to /brand-memory. (D) Smart Brand Memory screen (Profile -> profile-row-bulb, and deep-link /brand-memory both work): toggle (memory-enabled-toggle), tone input (memory-tone-input), add keyword chip (memory-keyword-input + memory-add-keyword produces memory-kw-<kw> chip), and Save (memory-save-button) — reload of /brand-memory shows tone='warm and playful' and keyword chip persisted. Cleanup performed (removed test keyword + cleared tone on demo). (E) Regression on demo: tabs Home/Incubator/Studio/Profile all navigate correctly, Recent Projects section still visible on Home, Insights & Analytics + Smart Brand Memory + Surprises & Milestones + Privacy Policy + Terms of Service rows all listed on Profile. RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents) still emitted — carry-over from iterations 1-3, documented, not a regression. No deprecated Expo packages detected in code (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports).
